memberdef.initializer: if (PassBuilder::checkParametrizedPassName(Name, NAME)) { \ auto Params = PassBuilder::parsePassParameters(PARSER, Name, NAME); \ if (!Params) { \ errs() << NAME ": " << toString(Params.takeError()) << '\n'; \ return false; \ } \ PM.addPass(CREATE_PASS(Params.get())); \ return true; \ }
